raw_data: ATL13 all dates (192/23); Sentinel-2 L2A (coverage-aware masks); SWORD stem
statistical_result: F4 +0.280 m [+0.138,+0.367]; residual offset -0.595 m (n=678); extent: descriptive only (n_pre=1)
qa_status: M2.1 SUPPORTED; M3.2 SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATION; M3.1 descriptive; C-02 UNSUPPORTED, C-03 CONTRADICTED

publication_readiness: READY as validation block; do not claim universal agreement; C-15 LakeSP transition NOT ready
